scope: Read-only audit of owner-maintained GitHub repository records at the pinned commits below. No DrivenData submission receipt or live leaderboard page was fetched in this review.
score_evidence_policy: All supplied site scores are USER/OWNER-REPORTED claims unless an organizer receipt that binds the exact submission to the score is available. No such receipt was verified in this review. A local mirror, TIFF hash, model projection, HOLDOUT-DTI, or owner statement does not establish ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED evidence.

strongest_supplied.evidence_status: USER/OWNER-REPORTED, UNVERIFIED. GEMSDOE24 registry/submission metadata has live_dti and score_evidence null and describes the artifact as unscored; no organizer receipt was found in the pinned source set.
strongest_supplied.current_site_status: The current page lists H24-GVC1 as 0.148763 HOLDOUT-DTI (evaluator gems-segment-pooled-v1; 60,988 withheld positives; 95% CI [0.134135, 0.163703]) and the newer H24-RSHG1 as 0.128994 HOLDOUT-DTI (same evaluator and withheld count; 95% CI [0.115783, 0.143050]). Both are internal holdout estimates, not leaderboard scores, and explicitly DO_NOT_SUBMIT; GVC1 exceeds the 70% 3-px overlap stop and RSHG1 also fails its stated promotion/overlap gates.
